name: Tag (modalselect)
xml:
<field
	type="ModalSelect"
	name="tag"
	label="Tag"
	sql_title_table="#__###component###_tag"
	sql_title_column="name"
	sql_title_key="guid"
	urlSelect="index.php?option=com_###component###&view=tags&layout=modal&tmpl=component&titleKey=guid"
	urlNew="index.php?option=com_###component###&task=tag.add&layout=modal&tmpl=component"
	urlEdit="index.php?option=com_###component###&task=tag.edit&guid={id}&layout=modal&tmpl=component&titleKey=guid"
	titleSelect="Select a Tag"
	titleNew="New Tag"
	titleEdit="Edit Tag"
	iconSelect="icon-copy"
	select="true"
	new="true"
	edit="true"
	clear="true"
	required="true"
	validate="guid"
	class="input-large"
	hint="Select a Tag"
/>
